title: FPF A/B Experiment Configuration
description: Experiment design configuration for causal inference via Rubin Causal Model (RCM). Defines treatment/control conditions, randomization strategy, outcome measures, and methodology assumptions. External tools consume this to set up, validate, and analyze controlled experiments measuring FPF effectiveness.

treatment_condition.description: Treatment: FPF skill loaded and active

blocking_variables.description: Covariates to block/stratify on for balance. Recommended: [domain, complexity_score]

sample_size_target.description: Target number of observations. Brier score requires n > 1000 for rare events (Wilks 2010).

allocation_ratio.description: Proportion allocated to treatment. 0.5 = balanced. 1.0 = all treatment.

primary.description: Primary outcome: proportion of 5 diagnostic gates passed

assumptions.description: RCM assumptions that must hold for valid causal inference

sutva_justification.description: Stable Unit Treatment Value Assumption justification: no interference between units, consistent treatment implementation. Default: sessions are independent, FPF loading status does not cross-contaminate across sessions.

unconfoundedness_justification.description: Unconfoundedness/ignorability justification: treatment assignment independent of potential outcomes given covariates. Default: treatment randomized, covariates balanced by design.

overlap_justification.description: Overlap/common support justification: treatment feasible across all covariate ranges. Default: FPF can be loaded or not loaded in any session regardless of domain or complexity.

estimators.description: Estimators to apply. difference_in_means is simplest, doubly_robust is recommended for most cases.

end_timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when experiment ends. null if ongoing.
